mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notice (user_id, title, content) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{content})
mapper.select: SELECT n.*, u.name as authorName, u.company_name as authorCompany FROM notice n JOIN user u ON n.user_id = u.user_id WHERE n.notice_id = #{noticeId}
SELECT n.*, u.name as authorName, u.company_name as authorCompany FROM notice n JOIN user u ON n.user_id = u.user_id ORDER BY n.notice_id DESC
